services.name: Summer Camp
services.desc: Tuition is due at the time of enrollment to ensure your child’s spot in the program. We cannot hold spots without payment. Payment plans are available in specific cases. Information about Financial Aid can be found here. Registrations are non-refundable. In our two-week-long sessions, campers learn theatre skills, make a mini movie, and act in a culminating performance. Skills taught include improv, projection, staging, dancing, character work, clowning, acting on film, and more. Campers also get the experience of being a part of an ensemble, the performance equivalent of a team! Our passionate staff bring unique skills and perspectives to each session.
